claims.statement: The Commission says energy communities can act as a single entity and access suitable energy markets.
The Commission reported more than 8000 energy communities across the EU in 2025.

economics.acquisition_route: Installer referrals and targeted outreach to municipalities and high-load SMEs
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated: 50 projects could support about 1.2m PLN annual revenue; 250 projects and EU replication could support 6m PLN, making over 5m PLN founder equity plausible in years 5-7 at 70% ownership
economics.founder_time: 2-4 hours/day initially, with legal work contracted
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated: 65-80% after meter-data review and contract support
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 1500 PLN project listing plus 1% of first-year contracted electricity value
economics.retention_or_repeat: Developers reuse the book for each project; SMEs renew or add sites annually

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A proprietary map of local load, conversion rates and fulfilled commitments improves matching and becomes the default origination channel
fingerprint.customer: Polish energy-community developers, municipalities and renewable installers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Begin with the founder family's installer network, then municipal and installer partnerships
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Narrow exchange for metered-load profiles, conditional offtake reservations and reusable counterparty data rooms
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Developer pays a listing fee and success fee when a verified SME load commitment is signed
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A local generation project needs credible committed demand before financing or construction

structure.critical_dependency: Polish contracting and settlement rules must permit a low-friction conditional commitment

thesis: Aggregate conditional electricity-purchase commitments from Polish SMEs so energy-community developers can prove anchor demand before investing, then charge on a signed commitment.
title: Energy-Community Anchor-Load Reservation Book
uncertainties: Polish demand, pricing and unit economics are unvalidated
The minimum useful local load density is unknown
